entry.title: New Hands for Atlas | Boston Dynamics

media:group.media:title: New Hands for Atlas | Boston Dynamics
media:group.media:description:
This new generation hand is the perfect companion for Atlas. With 13 degrees of freedom, these hands are directly actuated, built for high fidelity simulation to enable sim-to-real RL, and designed from the ground up for dexterous physical work.
Learn how we built robot hands for modern AI and real work: https://bostondynamics.com/blog/robot-hands-for-modern-ai-and-real-work

entry.title: Inside the Robotics Race | Boston Dynamics x Hyundai Motor Group x Bloomberg Media Studios

media:group.media:title: Inside the Robotics Race | Boston Dynamics x Hyundai Motor Group x Bloomberg Media Studios
media:group.media:description:
Why will Boston Dynamics win the humanoid robotics race? We've already commercialized autonomous mobile robots, creating markets with Spot and Stretch. Now we're doing it again with Atlas: learning in real environments, designing for manufacturing at scale, and introducing a new era of physical intelligence.
Learn more RMAC: https://bostondynamics.com/news/boston-dynamics-opens-robotics-metaplant-application-center-to-train-humanoid-robots-for-manufacturing-tasks/ Learn more about Atlas: https://bostondynamics.com/products/atlas/

entry.title: Spot at Mariana Minerals | Boston Dynamics

media:group.media:title: Spot at Mariana Minerals | Boston Dynamics
media:group.media:description: Mariana Minerals is the world's first software-first mining company, using rich data sources from the field to optimize their operations. They are deploying Spot at their Copper One facility in Utah to help capture the data they need, automating routine inspections and reducing strain on operators in the field.

entry.title: Atlas' Journey to FIFA World Cup 2026™ | Boston Dynamics

media:group.media:title: Atlas' Journey to FIFA World Cup 2026™ | Boston Dynamics
media:group.media:description:
Following Atlas' first-of-its-kind live performance at the FIFA World Cup 2026™, we caught up with Seth Davis, senior program manager, to learn how this demonstration came together and what it takes to succeed in the field (and on the pitch).

media:group.media:title: Going the Extra Mile with Spot | Boston Dynamics
media:group.media:description:
Boston Dynamics is testing a last-mile delivery solution. Spot will help get packages from van to doorstep with less strain and greater efficiency.
Learn more about how and why we're taking on one of the biggest supply chain challenges: https://bostondynamics.com/blog/bridging-the-porch-gap/
